versions.content: Service Name Dem_DcmGetInfoTypeValue79 Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_DcmGetInfoTypeValue79 ( Dcm_OpStatusType OpStatus, uint8 * DataValueBuffer, uint8 * DataValueBufferSize ) Service ID [hex] 0xc3 Sync/Async Synchronous 5 270 of 536 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R21-11 4 Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) OpStatus OpStatus "Only DCM_INITIAL will appear, because this API behaves synchronous." Parameters (inout) DataValueBufferSize The maximum number of data bytes that can be written to the DataValueBuffer. When the function returns, the value is updated with the actual number of data bytes that are written to the Data ValueBuffer. Parameters (out) DataValueBuffer Buffer containing the contents of the monitor activity denominator. The buffer is provided by the caller with the appropriate size. Return value Std_ReturnType Always E_OK is returned Description Service to report the value of monitor activity denominator PID computed by the Dem. API is needed in OBD-relevant ECUs only. API Availability: This API will be available only if: ({ecucDem/DemGeneral.DemOBDSupport)} != DEM_OBD_NO_OBD_SUPPORT) Available via Dem_Dcm.h
